left.title: Jeff Sessions' 'Religious Liberty Task Force' Declares Holy War on LGBT People
left.body: The Attorney General's new 'Religious Liberty Task Force' will ensure that the Trump administration's program of discrimination against LGBT people and others continues unchecked.
left.roundup: Attorney General Jeff Sessions announced that the Department of Justice will establish a Religious Liberty Task Force to “protect and promote religious liberty."

center.title: Sessions announces 'religious liberty task force'
center.body: Attorney General Jeff Sessions announced Monday that the Department of Justice is creating a "religious liberty task force."
center.roundup: Attorney General Jeff Sessions announced that the Department of Justice will establish a Religious Liberty Task Force to “protect and promote religious liberty."

right.title: Jeff Sessions forms Religious Liberty Task Force to protect freedom of religion
right.body: The Justice Department on Monday announced the formation of a Religious Liberty Task Force aimed at ensuring religious groups’ protections when their beliefs conflict with government regulations.
right.roundup: Attorney General Jeff Sessions announced that the Department of Justice will establish a Religious Liberty Task Force to “protect and promote religious liberty."
